name: Summer Drifting
source:
With summer nearing its end, and Shuri soon leaving the country, you're faced with a choice: Will you take the risk and confess your feelings — even if it means losing the friendship you cherish? Or will you stay silent, enjoying the present moments as they are, while keeping your true feelings hidden.

[From [url=https://nekopyun.itch.io/summer-drifting]Itch.io[/url]]
